figures.caption: 圖：巷弄裡的彩繪階梯
figures.description: 一條老社區巷子裡的水泥階梯被漆成彩虹色，每一階還畫著一對翅膀。階梯中段，一名年輕女生張開雙臂擺姿勢，她的朋友蹲在地上用手機替她拍照；階梯下方還有十多名遊客拿著自拍棒排隊，等著輪到自己。人群旁邊一位提著菜籃的老太太被擋住，無法走上階梯回家，皺著眉頭看著他們。旁邊一戶人家的門上貼著手寫字條：「請降低音量」。

questions.stem: 提示：在社群媒體上爆紅的拍照景點，常吸引大批遊客專程前往打卡，但這些地點有時就在居民日常生活的巷弄裡。請根據下圖，寫一篇英文作文，文分兩段。第一段描述圖中彩繪階梯前的情景；第二段說明這類打卡熱潮可能對當地帶來哪些影響，並提出你對這種現象的看法。

1.explanation_zh: 第一段描述圖中的情景；第二段有兩個任務：打卡熱潮對當地的影響，以及你的看法。影響可以兼顧好壞（商機與居民的困擾），看法要明確，例如贊成但遊客要守規矩，或認為社區應該設限；只寫「拍照很好玩」會離題。
evidence: 第一段描述圖中彩繪階梯前的情景
第二段說明這類打卡熱潮可能對當地帶來哪些影響
1.strategy_zh: 圖中的老太太和「請降低音量」字條是寫居民受影響的線索；寫看法時可以加上具體做法，讓結論不只是重述。
hints: 第一段：先寫階梯，再寫拍照的人與排隊的遊客，最後寫被擋住的居民
第二段：先寫一項好的影響，再用轉折寫壞的影響
看法最好附上一兩個具體做法

moves.zh: 描述圖中彩繪階梯前的情景
說明這類打卡熱潮可能對當地帶來哪些影響
提出你對這種現象的看法

content.focus_zh: 第一段要寫出彩繪階梯、擺姿勢與拍照的人、排隊的遊客、被擋住的居民與門上的字條；第二段要有至少一項好的或壞的影響（商機、噪音、垃圾、通行），並提出明確看法，最好有自己或親友到打卡景點的具體經驗。

bands.descriptor_zh: 回應題目的每一項要求，主旨明確；用具體的事例、細節或親身經驗撐起每個重點。
大致回應題目，但有一項要求寫得單薄，或細節偏籠統、說服力不足。
漏掉題目的主要要求或主旨模糊，多數句子空泛、重複或偏離題目。
空白、離題、只抄題目，或內容少到無法判斷要說什麼。

organization.focus_zh: 第一段由階梯本身寫到周圍的人；第二段先寫影響、再提出看法與做法，影響的好壞之間要有轉折。

bands.descriptor_zh: 兩段分工清楚，各有主題句；句與句、段與段的銜接自然，轉承語用得恰當，篇幅分配合理。
段落大致分明，但有的地方跳接或重複，轉承語偏少或用得生硬。
重點排列混亂，前後句常接不起來，讀者不容易跟上。
看不出段落與順序，句子彼此無關。

grammar.focus_zh: 描述圖片用現在進行式與現在完成式（has been painted），經驗用過去式；as if、while 等連接詞要接完整子句。

bands.descriptor_zh: 句子幾乎沒有文法、標點錯誤，能交替使用簡單句、複句與不同的句首。
偶有時態、單複數或標點錯誤，但讀得懂意思；句型變化有限。
錯誤多到常讓人誤解意思，句子結構常不完整。
幾乎沒有正確的句子，無法理解。

vocabulary.focus_zh: 景點與社區相關的字（tourist、resident、neighborhood、lane、crowd、souvenir）要用對，避免整段只用 people 與 bad。

bands.descriptor_zh: 用字精準、貼切，搭配自然，少有重複；拼字與大小寫幾乎全對。
字彙範圍偏窄、常重複同幾個字，偶有用字不當或拼錯，但不妨礙理解。
用錯字或拼錯字很多，常讓人看不懂。
幾乎每個字都用錯或拼錯，無法理解。

rubric.deductions_zh: 字數明顯不足（少於 100 個單詞）或沒有分成兩段，各扣總分 1 分；兩種情形同時發生只扣 1 分。離題或空白以 0 分計。

model_texts.label: steady
model_texts.text:
The picture shows a narrow lane in an old neighborhood, where a set of stairs has been painted in rainbow colors. In the middle of the stairs, a young woman is opening her arms and smiling, while her friend is squatting down to take pictures of her with a phone. At the bottom, more than ten tourists with selfie sticks are waiting in line for their turn. Next to the crowd, an old woman with a basket of vegetables is trying to walk up the stairs to her home, but she cannot get through. On a nearby door, there is a note that asks visitors to keep their voices down.
Popular photo spots can affect a neighborhood in several ways. First, they bring more visitors, so small shops and restaurants nearby can earn more money. However, the crowds also cause problems for the people who live there. For example, my aunt lives near a famous painted wall in Taichung. When I visited her last month, several tourists were sitting on her steps and taking photos. She had to ask them to move before she could go inside. Every weekend, people also talk loudly and leave trash in front of her door. In my opinion, it is fine to take photos at these places, but visitors should remember that the spots are also people’s homes. In short, a good photo should never cost local people their peace.

self_assessment.explanation_zh: 描述完整，影響兼顧好壞，並有阿姨家門口的親身見聞，看法明確（內容 4）；兩段各有主題句，列舉與轉折清楚（組織 4）；關係副詞 where、完成式被動與時間子句正確（文法句構 4）；用字正確但較平實（字彙拼字 3）。總分 15，屬穩健版。

model_texts.label: top
model_texts.text:
Tucked away in an old neighborhood, a once-ordinary staircase has been transformed into a rainbow, each step decorated with a pair of painted wings. Halfway up, a young woman spreads her arms as if she were about to fly, while her friend crouches on the ground, adjusting the phone camera for the perfect angle. Below them, more than ten visitors holding selfie sticks are waiting in line for their turn, checking their hair and rehearsing their poses. What they fail to notice is an elderly woman at the edge of the crowd, holding a basket of vegetables and frowning because she cannot climb the stairs to her own home. On the door beside her, a handwritten note politely asks visitors to lower their voices, a quiet sign that the residents have had enough.
Photo spots like this can breathe new life into a quiet neighborhood. A painted staircase costs little, yet it may attract thousands of visitors a month, and nearby noodle stands, drink shops, and souvenir stores profit from the crowds. However, the benefits rarely reach every resident, while the costs fall on those who simply want to live there. Last summer, I visited a famous mural lane in Tainan with my friends, and we waited forty minutes for a single photo. During that time, I noticed an old man who had to push his scooter through the crowd to reach his own front door, and nobody stepped aside until he shouted. At that moment, I felt more like an intruder than a tourist. In my opinion, the problem lies not in the photo spots themselves but in the way visitors treat them. Some communities have already found sensible solutions. For example, they set quiet hours after 6 p.m. or paint a line on the ground to keep the path clear for residents. Visitors, in turn, should keep their voices down, take their trash home, and step aside for the people who live there. After all, a photo spot is worth visiting only as long as the people living behind the scenery can still call it home.

paragraphs.function_zh: 描述圖片：從被改造的階梯寫到拍照的人、排隊的遊客，再用沒被注意到的居民與字條點出衝突
paragraphs.topic_sentence: Tucked away in an old neighborhood, a once-ordinary staircase has been transformed into a rainbow, each step decorated with a pair of painted wings.

self_assessment.explanation_zh: 描述有層次並點出遊客與居民的衝突，影響兼顧商機與代價，經驗有時間與數字，看法附具體做法並以見解作結（內容 5）；由好處、代價、經驗到主張與做法層層推進（組織 5）；分詞構句、as if 假設、what 子句與 not … but 正確（文法句構 5）；用字精確（transformed、intruder、sensible），以常用字為主（字彙拼字 4）。總分 19，屬頂標版。

top.comment_zh: 第一段由彩虹翅膀階梯寫到擺姿勢的女生、蹲著拍照的朋友、排隊遊客、被擋住的提菜籃老太太與門上字條，as if、分詞構句運用自然；第二段先寫商機，再以 However 轉到居民承擔代價，用台南壁畫巷等四十分鐘、看到老先生推機車回家的經驗佐證，接著提出看法與社區、遊客兩方面的具體做法，結尾回扣 call it home。字彙（intruder、resident、souvenir stores）精準，無語言錯誤。

steady.comment_zh: 第一段寫到彩繪階梯、擺姿勢與拍照的人、排隊遊客、上不了樓梯的老太太與門上字條；第二段一項好影響、兩項壞影響，以阿姨家門口被遊客坐滿的經驗佐證，再提出看法，回應每項要求。完成式被動 has been painted 用得對，無語言錯誤；people 出現多次、句型以簡單句與 when 子句為主，較平實。

top.comment_zh: 第一段由階梯、擺姿勢與拍照的人、排隊的遊客，寫到被擋住的老太太與門上字條，並用 a quiet sign that the residents have had enough 點出重點；第二段有商機、居民的代價、台南排隊四十分鐘的經驗、社區的解決辦法與遊客該做的事。句型多變，用字精準，無錯誤。

steady.comment_zh: 第一段把階梯、擺姿勢與拍照的人、排隊的遊客、被擋住的老太太與字條都寫到；第二段有好處（商機）、壞處（姑姑家門前被占、噪音與垃圾）與明確看法，並以親戚的經驗支持。文法與拼字正確；字彙偏簡單，people 重複，句型變化有限。
